creatures.name: Onion
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new original squishy companion in the same family as the reference: extremely soft short fuzzy plush, glossy dark bead eyes, tiny mouth, rosy cheeks, adorable gentle 3D toy styling. IMPORTANT: make the body the new specified silhouette, not the reference's pillow shape. No feet, legs, toes, clothes or hard edges. Only defining shape features requested below. Tiny side nubs are fine. Single sprite atlas, exactly 1536x1024, 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512x512 cells. SAME new character in all six cells, centered at consistent scale with generous transparent margins. Six expressions in order: top row happy, calm, sleepy; bottom row sad, overwhelmed, focused. Focused is quietly determined, not angry. Real transparent background, transparent gaps, no cast floor, decorative glow, grid, text, labels, logos or watermark. New character: a little round pearl-cream onion with softly sculpted layered segments, a lavender blush at its base, pointed crown and two tiny soft green sprout leaves. Its face is on the round onion body.
